pli-tv-kd6:1.1.1: mahāvaggapāḷiyā dutiyo bhāgo namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa. 6. bhesajjakkhandhakaṃ tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ sāradikena ābādhena phuṭṭhānaṃ yāgupi pītā uggacchati. bhattampi bhuttaṃ uggacchati.
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.3: te tena kisā honti lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā.
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.4: addasā kho bhagavā te bhikkhū kise lūkhe dubbaṇṇe uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāte dhamanisanthatagatte. disvāna āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.5: “kinnukho ānanda etarahi bhikkhū kisā lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā, dhamanisanthatagattā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.6: “etarahi bhante bhikkhūnaṃ sāradikena ābādhena phuṭṭhānaṃ yāgupi pītā uggacchati. bhattampi bhuttaṃ uggacchati.
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.7: te tena kisā honti lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā, dhamanisanthatagattā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.1: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.2: “etarahi kho bhikkhūnaṃ sāradikena ābādhena phuṭṭhānaṃ yāgupi pītā uggacchati. bhattampi bhuttaṃ uggacchati.
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.3: te tena kisā lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā.
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.4: kinnu kho ahaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhesajjaṃ anujāneyyaṃ, yaṃ bhesajjañceva assa bhesajjasammatañca lokassa. āhāratthañca phareyya. na ca oḷāriko āhāro paññāyeyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.8: bhesajjāni ceva bhesajjasammatāni ca lokassa. āhāratthañca pharanti. na ca oḷāriko āhāro paññāyati.
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.9: yannūnāhaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ imāni pañca bhesajjāni anujāneyyaṃ kāle paṭiggahetvā kāle paribhuñjitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.2: “idha mayhaṃ. bhikkhave, rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.3: ‘etarahi kho bhikkhūnaṃ sāradikena ābādhena phuṭṭhānaṃ yāgupi pītā uggacchati. bhattampi bhuttaṃ uggacchati.
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.4: te tena kisā lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā.
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.5: kinnu kho ahaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhesajjaṃ anujāneyyaṃ yaṃ kho bhesajjaṃ ceva assa, bhesajjasammatañca lokassa. āhāratthañca phareyya. na ca oḷāriko āhāro paññāyeyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.9: bhesajjāni ceva bhesajjasammatāni ca lokassa. āhāratthañca pharanti. na ca oḷāriko āhāro paññāyati.
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.10: yannūnāhaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ imāni pañca bhesajjāni anujāneyyaṃ kāle paṭiggahetvā kāle paribhuñjitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.11: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, tāni pañca bhesajjāni kāle paṭiggahetvā kāle paribhuñjitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū tāni pañca bhesajjāni kāle paṭiggahetvā kāle paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.4.2: tesaṃ yānipi tāni pākatikāni lūkhāni bhojanāni, tānipi nacchādenti. pageva senesitāni.
pli-tv-kd6:1.4.3: te tena ceva sāradikena ābādhena phuṭṭhā iminā ca bhattacchādakena tadubhayena bhiyosomattāya kisā honti lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā.
pli-tv-kd6:1.4.4: addasā kho bhagavā te bhikkhū bhiyyosomattāya kise lūkhe dubbaṇṇe uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāte dhamanisanthatagatte, disvāna āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.4.5: “kinnu kho, ānanda, etarahi bhikkhū bhiyyosomattāya kisā lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.5.1: “etarahi, bhante, bhikkhū tāni pañca bhesajjāni kāle paṭiggahetvā kāle paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.5.2: tesaṃ yānipi tāni pākatikāni lūkhāni bhojanāni tānipi nacchādenti. pageva senesikāni.
pli-tv-kd6:1.5.3: te tena ceva sāradikena ābādhena phuṭṭhā iminā ca bhattācchādakena tadubhayena bhiyyosomattāya kisā lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.5.4: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.5.5: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, tāni pañca bhesajjāni paṭiggahetvā kālepi vikālepi paribhuñjitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:2.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vasehi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:2.1.5: kāle paṭiggahitaṃ kāle nippakkaṃ kāle saṃsattaṃ telaparibhogena paribhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:2.2.1: vikāle ce bhikkhave, paṭiggahitaṃ vikāle nippakkaṃ vikāle saṃsattaṃ, tañce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti tiṇṇaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:2.2.2: kāle ce bhikkhave, paṭiggahitaṃ vikāle nippakkaṃ vikāle saṃsattaṃ, tañce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dvinnaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:2.2.3: kāle ce bhikkhave, paṭiggahitaṃ kāle nippakkaṃ vikāle saṃsattaṃ, taṃ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd6:2.2.4: kāle ce bhikkhave, paṭiggahitaṃ kāle nippakkaṃ kāle saṃsattaṃ, tañce paribhuñjeyya, anāpattī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:3.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mūlehi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:3.1.4: haliddiṃ, siṅgiveraṃ vacaṃ vacatthaṃ ativisaṃ kaṭukarohiṇiṃ usīraṃ, bhaddamuttakaṃ. yāni vā panaññānipi atthi mūlāni bhesajjāni, neva khādanīye khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti, na bhojanīye bhojanīyatthaṃ pharanti, tāni
pli-tv-kd6:3.2.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mūlehi bhesajjehi piṭṭhehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kasāvehi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:4.1.4: nimbakasāvaṃ kuṭajakasāvaṃ paṭolakasāvaṃ siggavakasāvaṃ nattamālakasāvaṃ. yāni vā panaññānipi atthi kasāvāni bhesajjāni neva khādanīye khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti, na bhojanīye bhojanīyatthaṃ pharanti tāni –
pli-tv-kd6:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṇṇehi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:5.1.4: nimbapaṇṇaṃ kuṭajapaṇṇaṃ paṭolapaṇṇaṃ sulasipaṇṇaṃ kappāsapaṇṇaṃ. yāni vā panaññānipi atthi paṇṇāni bhesajjāni neva khādanīye khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti, na bhojanīye bhojanīyatthaṃ pharanti,
pli-tv-kd6:5.1.5: tāni paṭiggahetvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati paccaye paribhuñjituṃ. asati paccaye paribhuñjantassa āpatti dukkaṭassā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:6.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phalehi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:6.1.4: viḷaṅgaṃ pipphaliṃ maricaṃ harīṭakaṃ vibhīṭakaṃ āmalakaṃ goṭṭhaphalaṃ, yāni vā panaññāni pi atthi phalāni bhesajjāni, neva khādanīye khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti, na bhojanīye bhojanīyatthaṃ pharanti,
pli-tv-kd6:6.1.5: tāni paṭiggahetvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ. sati paccaye paribhuñjituṃ. asati paccaye paribhuñjantassa āpatti dukkaṭassā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ jatūhi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:7.1.4: hiṃgu hiṃgujatu hiṃgusipāṭikaṃ takaṃ takapattiṃ takapaṇṇiṃ sajjulasaṃ, yāni vā panaññānipi atthi jatūni bhesajjāni neva khādanīye khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti,
pli-tv-kd6:7.1.5: na bhojanīye bhojanīyatthaṃ pharanti, tāni paṭiggahetvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati paccaye paribhuñjituṃ. asati paccaye paribhuñjantassa āpatti dukkaṭassā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:8.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ loṇehi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:8.1.4: sāmuddaṃ kāḷaloṇaṃ, sindhavaṃ ubbhidaṃ biḷālaṃ, yāni vā panaññānipi atthi loṇāni bhesajjāni, neva khādanīye khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti, na bhojanīye bhojanīyatthaṃ pharanti, tāni
pli-tv-kd6:9.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato ānandassa upajjhāyassa āyasmato belaṭṭhasīsassa thullakacchābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:9.1.2: tassa lasikāya cīvarāni kāye lagganti. tāni bhikkhū udakena temetvā temetvā apakaḍḍhanti.
pli-tv-kd6:9.1.3: addasā kho bhagavā senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto te bhikkhū tāni cīvarāni udakena temetvā temetvā apakaḍḍhante, disvāna yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:9.1.5: “imassa bhante āyasmato thullakacchābādho. lasikāya cīvarāni kāye lagganti. tāni mayaṃ udakena temetvā temetvā apakaḍḍhāmā”ti .
pli-tv-kd6:9.2.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:9.2.2: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, yassa kaṇḍu vā piḷakā vā assāvo vā thullakacchu vā ābādho, kāyo vā duggandho, cuṇṇāni bhesajjāni.
pli-tv-kd6:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cuṇṇehi bhesajjehi cālitehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:10.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno amanussikābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:10.2.2: taṃ ācariyupajjhāyā upaṭṭhahantā nāsakkhiṃsu arogaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:10.2.3: so sūkarasūnaṃ gantvā āmakamaṃsañca khādi. āmakalohitañca pivi.
pli-tv-kd6:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno cakkhurogābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:11.1.2: taṃ bhikkhū pariggahetvā uccārampi passāvampi nikkhāmenti.
pli-tv-kd6:11.1.3: addasā kho bhagavā senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto te bhikkhū taṃ bhikkhuṃ pariggahetvā uccārampi passāvampi nikkhāmente. disvāna yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:11.2.2: imaṃ mayaṃ pariggahetvā uccārampi passāvampi nikkhāmemā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:11.2.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:11.2.8: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, candanaṃ tagaraṃ kāḷānusāriyaṃ tālīsaṃ bhaddamuttaka”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū piṭṭhāni añjanāni thālakesupi sarāvakesupi nikkhipanti.
pli-tv-kd6:12.1.5: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacā añjaniyo dhārenti:
pli-tv-kd6:12.1.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave, aṭṭhimayaṃ dantamayaṃ visāṇamayaṃ naḷamayaṃ veḷumayaṃ kaṭṭhamayaṃ jatumayaṃ phalamayaṃ lohamayaṃ saṅkhanābhimaya”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:12.2.1: tena kho pana samayena añjaniyo apārutā honti, tiṇacuṇṇehipi paṃsukehipi okirīyanti.
pli-tv-kd6:12.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū aṅguliyā añjanti. akkhīni dukkhāni honti.
pli-tv-kd6:12.3.4: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacā añjanisalākāyo dhārenti
pli-tv-kd6:12.4.1: tena kho pana samayena añjanisalākā bhūmiyaṃ patitā pharusā hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:12.4.4: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū añjanimpi añjanisalākampi hatthena pariharanti.
pli-tv-kd6:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato pilindivacchassa sīsābhitāpo hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:13.1.9: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, natthuṃkaraṇi”nti. tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacā natthuṃkaraṇiyo dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpimayaṃ. manussā ujjhāyanti, khīyanti, vipācenti: “seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhogino”ti. bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “na bhikkhave, uccāvacā natthuṃkaraṇī dhāretabbā. yo dhāreyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anujānāmi bhikkhave, aṭṭhimayaṃ …pe… saṅkhanābhimaya”nti. natthuṃ visamaṃ āsiñcīnti. bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “anujānāmi bhikkhave, yamakaṃ natthukaraṇi”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:13.2.7: taññeva vaṭṭiṃ ālimpetvā pivanti. kaṇṭho ḍahati.
pli-tv-kd6:13.2.10: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacāni dhūmanettāni, dhārenti
pli-tv-kd6:13.2.18: tena kho pana samayena dhūmanettāni apārutāni honti. pāṇakā pavisanti.
pli-tv-kd6:13.2.21: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dhūmanettāni hatthena pariharanti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato pilindivacchassa vātābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.1.6: tasmiṃ kho pana telapāke majjaṃ pakkhipitabbaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.1.9: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atipakkhittamajjāni telāni pacanti. tāni pivitvā majjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.1.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave, yasmiṃ telapāke majjassa na ca vaṇṇo na ca gandho na ca raso paññāyati, evarūpaṃ majjapakkhittaṃ telaṃ pātu”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ bahuṃ atipakkhittamajjaṃ telaṃ pakkaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.2.2: atha kho bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi: “kathannu kho atipakkhittamajje tele paṭipajjitabba”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.2.5: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato pilindivacchassa bahutaraṃ telaṃ pakkaṃ hoti, telabhājanaṃ na vijjati.
pli-tv-kd6:14.3.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato pilindivacchassa aṅgavāto hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.4.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato pilindivacchassa pabbavāto hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.4.7: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato pilindivacchassa pādā phalitā honti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.4.13: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno gaṇḍābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.6.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.6.8: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, sati kappiyakārake paṭiggahāpetuṃ, asati kappiyakārake sāmaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.6.9: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena bhikkhunā visaṃ pītaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.6.15: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, yaṃ karonto patigaṇhāti, sveva paṭiggaho kato hoti. na puna paṭiggahāpetabbo”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.7.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno gharadinnakābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.7.4: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu duṭṭhagahaṇiko hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.7.7: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno paṇḍurogābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.7.10: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno chavidosābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.7.13: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu abhisannakāyo hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā pilindivaccho rājagahe pabbhāraṃ sodhāpeti leṇaṃ kattukāmo.
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.2: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro yenāyasmā pilindivaccho tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ pilindivacchaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro āyasmantaṃ pilindivacchaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.8: “tena hi bhante, bhagavantaṃ paṭipucchitvā mama āroceyyāthā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.9: “evaṃ mahārājā”ti kho āyasmā pilindivaccho rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.1: atha kho āyasmā pilindivaccho rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ seniyaṃ bimbisāraṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi. samādapesi. samuttejesi. sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.2: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro āyasmatā pilindivacchena dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ pilindivacchaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.3: atha kho āyasmā pilindivaccho bhagavato santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.4: “rājā bhante, māgadho seniyo bimbisāro ārāmikaṃ dātukāmo.
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.1: dutiyampi kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro yenāyasmā pilindivaccho tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ pilindivacchaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro āyasmantaṃ pilindivacchaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.6: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro āyasmato pilindivacchassa ārāmikaṃ paṭissutvā vissaritvā cirena satiṃ paṭilabhitvā aññataraṃ sabbatthakaṃ mahāmattaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.7: “yo mayā bhaṇe, ayyassa ārāmiko paṭissuto, dinno so ārāmiko”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.9: “kīva cirannu kho bhaṇe, ito hi taṃ hotī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.1: atha kho so mahāmatto rattiyo vigaṇetvā rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ seniyaṃ bimbisāraṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.3: “tena hi bhaṇe, ayyassa pañca ārāmikasatāni dehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.5: kho so mahāmatto rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa paṭissutvā āyasmato pilindivacchassa pañca ārāmikasatāni pādāsi. pāṭiyekko gāmo nivisi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.6: ārāmikagāmotipi naṃ āhaṃsu. pilindigāmotipi naṃ āhaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.7: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā pilindivaccho tasmiṃ gāmake kulūpago hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.8: atha kho āyasmā pilindivaccho pubbanhasamayaṃ* nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya pilindigāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.1: tena kho pana samayena tasmiṃ gāmake ussavo hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.3: atha kho āyasmā pilindivaccho pilindigāmake sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno yena aññatarassa ārāmikassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.4: tena kho pana samayena tassā ārāmikiniyā dhītā aññe dārake alaṅkate mālākite passitvā rodati:
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.6: atha kho āyasmā pilindivaccho taṃ ārāmikiniṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.8: “ayaṃ bhante, dārikā aññe dārake alaṅkate mālākite passitvā rodati:
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.10: kuto amhākaṃ duggatānaṃ mālā. kuto alaṅkāro”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.1: atha kho āyasmā pilindivaccho aññataraṃ tiṇaṇḍupakaṃ gahetvā taṃ ārāmikiniṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.3: atha kho sā ārāmikinī taṃ tiṇaṇḍupakaṃ gahetvā tassā dārikāya sīse paṭimuñci.
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.4: sā ahosi suvaṇṇamālā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā.
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.6: manussā rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa ārocesuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.7: “amukassa deva, ārāmikassa ghare suvaṇṇamālā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā.
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.11: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro taṃ ārāmikakulaṃ bandhāpesi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā pilindivaccho pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya pilindigāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.2: pilindigāmake sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno yena tassa ārāmikassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paṭivissake pucchi:
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.5: atha kho āyasmā pilindivaccho yena rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.6: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro yenāyasmā pilindivaccho tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ pilindivacchaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.7: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ seniyaṃ bimbisāraṃ āyasmā pilindivaccho etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.8.2: “tassa bhante, ārāmikassa ghare suvaṇṇamālā abhirūpā, dassanīyā pāsādikā.
pli-tv-kd6:15.8.6: atha kho āyasmā pilindivaccho rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa pāsādaṃ suvaṇṇanti adhimucci.
pli-tv-kd6:15.8.8: “idaṃ pana te mahārāja, tāva bahuṃ suvaṇṇaṃ kuto”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.8.9: ‘aññātaṃ bhante, ayyassa eso iddhānubhāvo”ti. taṃ ārāmikakulaṃ muñcāpesi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.2: “ayyena kira pilindivacchena sarājikāya parisāya uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassita”nti
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.3: attamanā abhippasannā āyasmato pilindivacchassa pañca bhesajjāni abhihariṃsu. seyyathidaṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.5: pakatiyāpi ca āyasmā pilindivaccho lābhī hoti pañcannaṃ bhesajjānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.8: laddhaṃ laddhaṃ kolambepi ghaṭepi pūretvā paṭisāmeti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.12: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti, khīyanti, vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.13: “antokoṭṭhāgārikā ime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā seyyathāpi rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti, khīyanti, vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.3: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū evarūpāya bāhullāya cetessantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.5: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, bhikkhū evarūpāya bāhullāya cetentī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.7: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.8: “yāni kho pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyanīyāni bhesajjāni, seyyathidaṃ: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahetvā sattāhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbāni. taṃ atikkāmayato yathā dhammo kāretabbo”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.1: atha kho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.2: addasā kho āyasmā kaṅkhārevato antarāmagge guḷakaraṇaṃ okkamitvā guḷe piṭṭhampi chārikampi pakkhipante. disvāna
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.3: “akappiyo guḷo. sāmiso. na kappati guḷo vikāle paribhuñjitu”nti
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.5: yepissa sotabbaṃ maññanti, tepi guḷaṃ na paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.9: “sace bhikkhave, bandhanatthāya guḷe piṭṭhampi chārikampi pakkhipanti, so ca guḷotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
pli-tv-kd6:16.2.1: addasā kho āyasmā kaṅkhārevato antarāmagge vacce muggaṃ jātaṃ. passitvā
pli-tv-kd6:16.2.5: yepissa sotabbaṃ maññanti tepi muggaṃ na paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:16.2.7: “sace bhikkhave, pakkāpi muggā jāyanti, anujānāmi bhikkhave, yathāsukhaṃ muggaṃ paribhuñjitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:16.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno udaravātābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.1.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena rājagahaṃ tadavasari. tatra sudaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd6:17.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavato udaravātābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.1.3: atha kho āyasmā ānando “pubbepi bhagavato udaravātābādho tekaṭulāya yāguyā phāsu hotī”ti
pli-tv-kd6:17.1.4: sāmaṃ tilampi taṇḍulampi muggampi viññāpetvā anto vāsetvā anto sāmaṃ pacitvā bhagavato upanāmesi
pli-tv-kd6:17.2.1: jānantāpi tathāgatā pucchanti. jānantāpi na pucchanti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.2.2: kālaṃ viditvā pucchanti. kālaṃ viditvā na pucchanti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.2.5: dvīhi ākārehi buddhā bhagavanto bhikkhū paṭipucchanti: dhammaṃ vā desissāma sāvakānaṃ vā sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.2.6: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi “kuto’yaṃ ānanda, yāgū”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.2.7: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.3: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ ānanda, evarūpāya bāhullāya cetessasi?
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.4: yadapi ānanda, anto vutthaṃ, tadapi akappiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.8: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.9: “na bhikkhave, anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.4.1: anto ce bhikkhave, vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ tañce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti tiṇṇaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.4.2: anto ce bhikkhave, vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ aññehi pakkaṃ, tañce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dvinnaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.4.3: anto ce bhikkhave, vutthaṃ bahi pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ, tañce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dvinnaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.5.1: bahi ce bhikkhave, vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ, tañce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dvinnaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.5.2: anto ce bhikkhave vutthaṃ bahi pakkaṃ aññehi pakkaṃ, tañce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

pli-tv-kd6:17.5.4: bahi ce bhikkhave, vutthaṃ bahi pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ, tañce paribhuñjeyya āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd6:17.5.5: bahi ce bhikkhave, vutthaṃ bahi pakkaṃ aññehi pakkaṃ, tañce paribhuñjeyya, anāpattī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.7.1: tena kho pana samayena rājagahaṃ dubbhikkhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.7.2: manussā loṇampi telampi taṇḍulampi khādanīyampi ārāmaṃ āharanti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.7.4: ukkapiṇḍikāpi khādanti. corāpi haranti. damakāpi haranti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.7.12: dubbhikkhe kappiyakārakā bahutaraṃ haranti. appataraṃ bhikkhūnaṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.7.15: anujānāmi bhikkhave, anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakka”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.8.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū kāsīsu vassaṃ vutthā rājagahaṃ gacchantā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya antarāmagge na labhiṃsu lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.8.4: atha kho te bhikkhū kilantarūpā yena rājagahaṃ veḷuvanaṃ kalandakanivāpo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:17.8.5: āciṇṇaṃ kho panetaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.8.6: atha kho bhagavā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:17.9.2: idha mayaṃ bhante kāsīsu vassaṃ vutthā rājagahaṃ āgacchantā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya antarāmagge na labhimhā lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.9.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:17.9.7: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, yattha phalakhādanīyaṃ passati, kappiyakārako ca na hoti, sāmaṃ gahetvā haritvā kappiyakārakaṃ passitvā bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā paṭiggahāpetvā paribhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa navā ca tilā navañca madhu uppannā honti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.3: “yannūnāhaṃ nave ca tile navaṃ ca madhuṃ buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa dadeyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.4: atha kho so brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.5: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.6: “adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.8: atha kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:18.2.1: atha kho so brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
pli-tv-kd6:18.2.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena tassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd6:18.2.4: atha kho so brāhmaṇo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:18.2.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:18.3.1: atha kho tassa brāhmaṇassa acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:18.3.2: “yesaṃ kho mayā atthāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantito nave ca tile navaṃ ca madhuṃ dassāmī”ti te mayā pammuṭṭhā dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:18.3.3: yannūnāhaṃ nave ca tile navañca madhuṃ kolambehi ca ghaṭehi ca ārāmaṃ āharāpeyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.3.4: atha kho so brāhmaṇo nave ca tile navañca madhuṃ kolambehi ca ghaṭehi ca ārāmaṃ āharāpetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:18.3.5: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:18.4.1: “yesaṃ kho mayā bho gotama, atthāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantito ‘nave ca tile navañca madhuṃ dassāmī’ti, te mayā pamuṭṭhā dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:18.4.2: patigaṇhātu me bhavaṃ gotamo nave ca tile navañca madhu”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.4.4: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dubbhikkhe appamattakepi pavārenti, paṭisaṅkhāpi paṭikkhipanti,
pli-tv-kd6:18.4.5: sabbo ca saṅgho pavārito hoti. bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā na patigaṇhanti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.4.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave, tato nīhaṭaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ paribhuñjitu”nti.

pli-tv-kd6:19.1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭho hoti.

pli-tv-kd6:19.2.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dubbhikkhe appamattakepi pavārenti. paṭisaṅkhāpi paṭikkhipanti. sabbo ca saṅgho pavārito hoti.

pli-tv-kd6:20.2.5: “bhisehi ca me āvuso attho muḷālikāhi cā”ti.

pli-tv-kd6:20.3.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evameva mandākiniyā pokkharaṇiyā tīre antarahito jetavane pāturahosi.

pli-tv-kd6:20.4.4: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, vanaṭṭhaṃ pokkharaṭṭhaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ paribhuñjitu”nti.

pli-tv-kd6:22.2.9: “tassa bhante āyasmato bhagandalābādho. ākāsagotto vejjo satthakammaṃ karotī”ti.

pli-tv-kd6:22.4.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti, khīyanti, vipācenti:

pli-tv-kd6:23.1.1: atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena bārāṇasī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena bārāṇasī tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd6:23.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
pli-tv-kd6:23.1.4: tena kho pana samayena bārāṇasiyaṃ suppiyo ca upāsako suppiyā ca upāsikā ubho pasannā honti dāyakā kārakā saṅghupaṭṭhākā.
pli-tv-kd6:23.1.5: atha kho suppiyā upāsikā ārāmaṃ gantvā vihārena vihāraṃ pariveṇena pariveṇaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhū pucchati:
pli-tv-kd6:23.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena bhikkhunā virecanaṃ pītaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.2.2: atha kho so bhikkhu suppiyaṃ upāsikaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:23.2.8: “evaṃ ayye”ti kho so puriso suppiyāya upāsikāya paṭissutvā kevalakappaṃ bārāṇasiṃ āhiṇḍanto na addasa pavattamaṃsaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:23.2.9: atha kho so puriso yena suppiyā upāsikā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā suppiyaṃ upāsikaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.2: “tassa kho gilānassa bhikkhuno paṭicchādanīyaṃ alabhantassa ābādho vā abhivaḍḍhissati, kālaṅkiriyā vā bhavissati.
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.3: na kho me taṃ patirūpaṃ, yāhaṃ paṭissutvā na harāpeyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.4: potthanikaṃ gahetvā ūrumaṃsaṃ ukkantitvā dāsiyā adāsi:
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.5: “handa je imaṃ maṃsaṃ sampādetvā, amukasmiṃ vihāre bhikkhu gilāno, tassa dajjehi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.6: yo ca maṃ pucchati, ‘gilānāti paṭivedehī”ti. uttarāsaṅgena ūruṃ paveṭhetvā ovarakaṃ pavisitvā mañcake nipajji.
pli-tv-kd6:23.4.1: atha kho suppiyo upāsako gharaṃ gantvā dāsiṃ pucchi:
pli-tv-kd6:23.4.4: atha kho suppiyo upāsako yena suppiyā upāsikā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā suppiyaṃ upāsikaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:23.4.8: atha kho suppiyā upāsikā suppiyassa upāsakassa etamatthaṃ ārocesi.

pli-tv-kd6:23.5.1: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho suppiyo upāsako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:23.5.2: “adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.5.4: atha kho suppiyo upāsako bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.5.5: atha kho suppiyo upāsako tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: “kālo bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhatta”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.5.6: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena suppiyassa upāsakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd6:23.6.1: atha kho suppiyo upāsako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.6.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho suppiyaṃ upāsakaṃ bhagavā etadavoca: “kahaṃ suppiyā”ti.

pli-tv-kd6:24.1.3: “yadā paṭipāṭiṃ labhissāma, tadā bhattaṃ karissāmā”ti. pañcamattāni ca vighāsādasatāni.

pli-tv-kd6:24.4.9: atha kho so brāhmaṇo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pahūtāya yāguyā ca madhugoḷakena ca sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ dhotahatthaṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.

pli-tv-kd6:24.6.3: yāguṃ dento āyuṃ deti. vaṇṇaṃ deti. sukhaṃ deti. balaṃ deti. paṭibhānaṃ deti. yāgu pītā khudaṃ paṭihanti. pipāsaṃ paṭivineti. vātaṃ anulometi. vatthiṃ sodheti. āmāvasesaṃ pāceti.
pli-tv-kd6:24.7.1: atha kho bhagavā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:24.7.2: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.1: assosuṃ kho manussā “bhagavatā kira bhikkhūnaṃ yāgu anuññātā madhugoḷakañcā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.3: bhikkhū kālasseva bhojjāya yāguyā dhātā madhugoḷakena ca bhattagge na cittarūpaṃ bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.4: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena taruṇappasannena mahāmattena svātanāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantito hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.5: atha kho tassa taruṇappasannassa mahāmattassa etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.6: “yannūnāhaṃ aḍḍhateḷasannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ aḍḍhateḷasāni maṃsapātisatāni paṭiyādeyyaṃ, ekamekassa bhikkhuno ekamekaṃ maṃsapātiṃ upanāmeyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.2.1: atha kho so taruṇappasanno mahāmatto tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā aḍḍhateḷasāni ca maṃsapātisatāni bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: “kālo bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhatta”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.2.2: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena tassa taruṇappasannassa mahāmattassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd6:25.3.1: atha kho so taruṇappasanno mahāmatto bhattagge bhikkhū parivisati.
pli-tv-kd6:25.3.4: “mā kho tumhe bhante, ‘ayaṃ taruṇaplasanno mahāmatto’ti thokaṃ thokaṃ patigaṇhittha.
pli-tv-kd6:25.3.5: bahuṃ me khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, aḍḍhateḷasāni maṃsapātisatāni.
pli-tv-kd6:25.3.8: “na kho mayaṃ āvuso etaṃkāraṇā thokaṃ thokaṃ patigaṇhāma, api ca mayaṃ kālasseva bhojjāya yāguyā dhātā madhugoḷakena ca. tena mayaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ patigaṇhāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.4.1: atha kho so taruṇapasanno mahāmatto ujjhāyati, khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd6:25.4.2: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhadantā mayā nimantitā aññassa bhojjayāguṃ paribhuñjissanti. na cāhaṃ paṭibalo yāvadatthaṃ dātu”nti
pli-tv-kd6:25.4.3: kupito anattamano āsādanāpekkho bhikkhūnaṃ patte pūrento agamāsi “bhuñjatha vā. haratha vā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.4.4: atha kho so taruṇappasanno mahāmatto buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:25.4.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ taruṇappasannaṃ mahāmattaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.1: atha kho tassa taruṇappasannassa mahāmattassa acirapakkantassa bhagavato ahudeva kukkuccaṃ. ahu vippaṭisāro:
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.2: “alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.3: yohaṃ kupito anattamano āsādanāpekkho bhikkhūnaṃ patte pūrento agamāsiṃ ‘bhuñjatha vā haratha vā’ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.4: kinnu kho mayā bahuṃ pasutaṃ puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.5: atha kho so taruṇappasanno mahāmatto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.6: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so taruṇappasanno mahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.7: “idha mayhaṃ bhante acirapakkantassa bhagavato ahudeva kukkuccaṃ. ahu vippaṭisāro:
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.8: ‘alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.9: yohaṃ kupito anattamano āsādanāpekkho bhikkhūnaṃ patte pūrento agamāsiṃ ‘bhuñjatha vā haratha vā’ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.10: kinnu kho mayā bahuṃ pasutaṃ puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.11: kinnu kho mayā bhante bahuṃ pasutaṃ, puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.6.1: “yadaggena tayā āvuso, svātanāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantito, tadaggena te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasutaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:25.6.2: yadaggena te ekamekena bhikkhunā ekamekaṃ sitthaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ, tadaggena te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasutaṃ. saggā te āraddhā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.6.3: atha kho so taruṇappasanno mahāmatto “lābhā kira me. suladdhaṃ kira me. bahuṃ kira mayā puññaṃ pasutaṃ. saggā kira me āraddhā”ti
pli-tv-kd6:25.6.4: haṭṭho udaggo uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.2: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū aññatra nimantitā aññassa bhojjayāguṃ paribhuñjantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.5: hi nāma te bhikkhave, moghapurisā aññatra nimantitā aññassa bhojjayāguṃ paribhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.7: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.8: “na bhikkhave, aññatra nimantitena aññassa bhojjayāgu paribhuñjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd6:26.1.1: atha kho bhagavā andhakavinde yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.1.2: tena kho pana samayena belaṭṭho kaccāno rājagahā andhakavindaṃ addhānamaggappaṭipanno hoti pañcamattehi sakaṭasatehi sabbeheva guḷakumbhapūrehi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.1.3: addasā kho bhagavā belaṭṭhaṃ kaccānaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ. disvāna maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.1: atha kho belaṭṭho kaccāno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho belaṭṭho kaccāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.3: “icchāmahaṃ bhante ekamekassa bhikkhuno ekamekaṃ guḷakumbhaṃ dātu”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.4: “tena hi tvaṃ kaccāna, ekaṃyeva guḷakumbhaṃ āharā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.5: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho belaṭṭho kaccāno bhagavato paṭissutvā ekaṃyeva guḷakumbhaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.8: “tena hi tvaṃ kaccāna, bhikkhūnaṃ guḷaṃ dehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.1: “evaṃ, bhante”ti kho belaṭṭho kaccāno bhagavato paṭissutvā bhikkhūnaṃ guḷaṃ datvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.2: “dinno bhante, bhikkhūnaṃ guḷo. bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho.
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.4: “tena hi tvaṃ kaccāna, bhikkhūnaṃ guḷaṃ yāvadatthaṃ dehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.5: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho belaṭṭho kaccāno bhagavato paṭissutvā bhikkhūnaṃ guḷaṃ yāvadatthaṃ datvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.6: “dinno bhante, bhikkhūnaṃ guḷo yāvadattho. bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho.
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.8: “tena hi tvaṃ kaccāna, bhikkhū guḷehi santappehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.9: “evaṃ, bhante”ti kho belaṭṭho kaccāno bhagavato paṭissutvā bhikkhū guḷehi santappesi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.10: ekacce bhikkhū pattepi pūresuṃ. parissāvanānipi thavikāyopi pūresuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.1: atha kho belaṭṭho kaccāno bhikkhū guḷehi santappetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.2: “santappitā bhante bhikkhū guḷehi. bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho.
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.4: “tena hi tvaṃ kaccāna vighāsādānaṃ guḷaṃ dehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.5: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho belaṭṭho kaccāno bhagavato paṭissutvā vighāsādānaṃ guḷaṃ datvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.6: “dinno bhante vighāsādānaṃ guḷo. bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho.
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.8: “tena hi tvaṃ kaccāna, vighāsādānaṃ guḷaṃ yāvadatthaṃ dehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.5.1: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho belaṭṭho kaccāno bhagavato paṭissutvā vighāsādānaṃ guḷaṃ yāvadatthaṃ datvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.5.2: “dinno bhante, vighāsādānaṃ guḷo yāvadattho. bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho.
pli-tv-kd6:26.5.4: “tena hi tvaṃ kaccāna, vighāsāde guḷehi santappehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.5.5: “evaṃ, bhante”ti kho belaṭṭho kaccāno bhagavato paṭissutvā vighāsāde guḷehi santappesi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.5.6: ekacce vighāsādā kolambepi ghaṭepi pūresuṃ, piṭakānipi ucchaṅgepi pūresuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:26.6.1: atha kho belaṭṭho kaccāno vighāsāde guḷehi santappetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.6.2: “santappitā bhante vighāsādā guḷehi. bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho.
pli-tv-kd6:26.6.4: “nāhaṃ taṃ kaccāna, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yasseso guḷo paribhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā.
pli-tv-kd6:26.6.5: tena hi tvaṃ, kaccāna, taṃ guḷaṃ appaharite vā chaḍḍehi. appāṇake vā udake opilāpehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.6.6: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho belaṭṭho kaccāno bhagavato paṭissutvā taṃ guḷaṃ appāṇake udake opilāpesi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.7.1: atha kho so guḷo udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati.
pli-tv-kd6:26.7.2: seyyathāpi nāma phālo divasasantatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati, ciṭiciṭāyati, sandhūpāyati, sampadhūpāyati,
pli-tv-kd6:26.7.3: evameva so guḷo udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati. ciṭiciṭāyati. sandhūpāyati. sampadhūpāyati.
pli-tv-kd6:26.7.4: atha kho belaṭṭho kaccāno saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.8.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho belaṭṭhassa kaccānassa bhagavā anupubbīkathaṃ kathesi. seyyathidaṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:26.8.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.8.3: yadā bhagavā aññāsi belaṭṭhaṃ kaccānaṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi. (seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya,)
pli-tv-kd6:26.8.4: evameva belaṭṭhassa kaccānassa tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
pli-tv-kd6:26.8.5: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.9.1: atha kho belaṭṭho kaccāno diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.9.3: seyyathāpi bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vicareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya: cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī ti,
pli-tv-kd6:26.9.4: evamevaṃ kho bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
pli-tv-kd6:26.9.5: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
pli-tv-kd6:26.9.6: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:27.1.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena rājagahaṃ tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd6:27.1.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd6:27.1.3: tena kho pana samayena rājagahe guḷo ussanno hoti.

pli-tv-kd6:28.1.2: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena pāṭaligāmo tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd6:28.1.5: atha kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:28.1.6: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho pāṭaligāmike upāsake bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi. samādapesi. samuttejesi. sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd6:28.2.1: atha kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:28.2.2: “adhivāsetu no bhante bhagavā āvasathāgāraṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.2.4: atha kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena āvasathāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ āvasathāgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññapetvā, udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telappadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.1: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.7: atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena āvasathāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathā gāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.8: bhikkhusaṅghopi kho pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi bhagavantaṃyeva purakkhatvā.
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.9: pāṭaligāmikāpi kho upāsakā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchimābhimukhā nisīdiṃsu, bhagavantaṃyeva purakkhatvā.
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.10: atha kho bhagavā pāṭaligāmike upāsake āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.3: idha, gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno pamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahatiṃ bhogajāniṃ nigacchati.
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.5: puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, dussīlassa sīlavipannassa pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.7: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati: yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, avisārado upasaṅkamati maṅkubhūto.
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.9: puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno sammūḷho kālaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.11: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.13: ime kho gahapatayo, pañca ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.3: idha gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno appamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigacchati.
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.5: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, sīlavato sīlasampannassa kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.7: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati: yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.9: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.11: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.13: ime kho gahapatayo, pañca ānisaṃsā sīlavato sīlasampadāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.6.1: atha kho bhagavā pāṭaligāmike upāsake bahudeva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uyyojesi
pli-tv-kd6:28.6.4: “evaṃ bhante”ti, kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu pāṭaligāmikesu upāsakesu suññāgāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.2.1: tena kho pana samayena sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāya.
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.3: addasā kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sambahulā devatāyo pāṭaligāme vatthūni parigaṇhantiyo.
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.4: yasmiṃ padese mahesakkhā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, mahesakkhānaṃ tattha rājūnaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.5: yasmiṃ padese majjhimā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, majjhimānaṃ tattha rājūnaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.6: yasmiṃ padese nīcā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, nīcānaṃ tattha rājūnaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.7: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.8: “ko nu kho te ānanda, pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpentī”ti?
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.1: “sunīdhavassakārā, bhante, magadhamahāmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.3: evameva kho ānanda, sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāya.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.4: idhāhaṃ ānanda, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya addasaṃ dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sambahulā devatāyo pāṭaligāme vatthūni parigaṇhantiyo.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.5: yasmiṃ padese mahesakkhā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, mahesakkhānaṃ tattha rājūnaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.6: yasmiṃ padese majjhimā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, majjhimānaṃ tattha rājūnaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.7: yasmiṃ padese nīcā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, nīcānaṃ tattha rājūnaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.8: yāvatā ānanda, ariyaṃ āyatanaṃ, yāvatā vaṇippatho, idaṃ agganagaraṃ bhavissati pāṭaliputtaṃ puṭabhedanaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.9: pāṭaliputtassa kho ānanda, tayo antarāyā bhavissanti
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.10: aggito vā udakato vā abbhantarato vā mithubhedā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.9.1: atha kho sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.1: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.2: “adhivāsetu no bhavaṃ gotamo ajjatanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.4: atha kho sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā pakkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.5: atha kho sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesuṃ: “kālo bho gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhatta”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.6: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena sunīdhavassakārānaṃ magadhamahāmattānaṃ parivesanā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.7: atha kho sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.8: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho sunīdhavassakāre magadhamahāmatte bhagavā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi:
pli-tv-kd6:28.11.13: atha kho bhagavā sunīdhavassakāre magadhamahāmatte imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.1: tena kho pana samayena sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddhā honti:
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.2: “yena ajja samaṇo gotamo dvārena nikkhamissati, taṃ gotamadvāraṃ nāma bhavissati.
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.3: yena titthena gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ uttarissati, taṃ gotamatitthaṃ nāma bhavissatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.4: atha kho bhagavā yena dvārena nikkhami, taṃ gotamadvāraṃ nāma ahosi.
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.5: atha kho bhagavā yena gaṅgā nadī, tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.6: tena kho pana samayena gaṅgānadī pūrā hoti samatittikā kākapeyyā.
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.7: manussā aññe nāvaṃ pariyesanti; aññe uḷumpaṃ pariyesanti, aññe kullaṃ bandhanti orā pāraṃ gantukāmā.
pli-tv-kd6:28.13.1: addasā kho bhagavā te manusse aññe nāvaṃ pariyesante aññe uḷumpaṃ pariyesante aññe kullaṃ bandhante orā pāraṃ gantukāme. disvāna seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva bhagavā gaṅgāya nadiyā orimatīre antarahito pārimatīre paccuṭṭhāsi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd6:28.13.2: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd6:29.1.1: atha kho bhagavā yena koṭigāmo tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd6:29.1.4: “catunnaṃ bhikkhave, ariyasaccānaṃ ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamidaṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañceva tumhākañca.
pli-tv-kd6:29.1.6: dukkhassa bhikkhave, ariyasaccassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamidaṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañceva tumhākañca.
pli-tv-kd6:29.1.9: dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamidaṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañceva tumhākañca.
pli-tv-kd6:29.2.1: tayidaṃ bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ. dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ. dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ. dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ. ucchinnā bhavataṇhā. khīṇā bhavanetti. natthidāni punabbhavo”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.1.3: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi vesāliyā niyyāsi bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-kd6:30.1.4: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi, yānena gantvā, yānā paccorohitvā pattikāva yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:30.2.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ambapāliṃ gaṇikaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi. samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd6:30.2.2: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:30.2.3: “adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.2.5: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:30.3.3: atha kho vesālikā licchavī bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhadraṃ bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhirūhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi vesāliyā niyīṃsu bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-kd6:30.3.4: appekacce licchavī nīlā honti nīlavaṇṇā nīlavatthā nīlālaṅkārā. appekacce licchavī pītā honti pītavaṇṇā pītavatthā pītālaṅkārā. appekacce licchavī lohitakā honti lohitavaṇṇā lohitakavatthā lohitālaṅkārā. appekacce licchavī odātā honti odātavaṇṇā odātavatthā odātālaṅkārā.
pli-tv-kd6:30.3.5: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā daharānaṃ daharānaṃ licchavīnaṃ īsāya īsaṃ yugena yugaṃ cakkena cakkaṃ akkhena akkhaṃ pativaṭṭesi.
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.1: atha kho te licchavī ambapāliṃ gaṇikaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.2: “kissa je ambapāli, amhākaṃ daharānaṃ daharānaṃ licchavīnaṃ īsāya īsaṃ yugena yugaṃ cakkena cakkaṃ akkhena akkhaṃ pativaṭṭesī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.3: “tathā hi pana mayā ayyaputtā, svātanāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantito”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.4: “dehi je ambapāli, amhākaṃ etaṃ bhattaṃ satasahassenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.5: “sacepi me ayyaputtā vesāliṃ sāhāraṃ dajjeyyātha, neva dajjā bhatta”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.6: atha kho te licchavī aṅguliṃ phoṭesuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.7: “parājitamha vata bho ambakāya. parājitamha vata bho ambakāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.1: atha kho te licchavī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.2: addasā kho bhagavā te licchavī dūratova āgacchante. disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.3: “yehi bhikkhave, bhikkhūhi devā tāvatiṃsā adiṭṭhapubbā, oloketha bhikkhave, licchavīparisaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.6: atha kho te licchavī yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi, yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikāva yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu;
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.8: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te licchavī bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi. samādapesi. samuttejesi. sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.9: atha kho te licchavī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.10: “adhivāsetu no bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.12: atha kho te licchavī aṅguliṃ poṭhesuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.13: “parājitamha vata bho ambakāya. parājitamha vata bho ambakāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.14: atha kho te licchavī bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.1: atha kho bhagavā koṭigāme yathābhirattaṃ viharitvā yena nātikā tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.3: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā tassā rattiyā accayena sake ārāme paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: “kālo bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhatta”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.4: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena ambapāliyā gaṇikāya parivesanā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.5: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.8: atha kho bhagavā ambapāliṃ gaṇikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena mahāvanaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.9: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:31.1.1: tena kho pana samayena abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.1.2: tena kho pana samayena sīho senāpati nigaṇṭhasāvako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.1.4: “nissaṃsayaṃ kho so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhavissati. tathā hime abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.1.5: yannūnāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddha”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.2.1: atha kho sīho senāpati yena nigaṇṭho nātaputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sīho senāpati nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:31.2.3: “kiṃ pana tvaṃ sīha, kiriyavādo samāno akiriyavādaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissasi?
pli-tv-kd6:31.2.4: samaṇo hi sīha, gotamo akiriyavādo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.2.5: atha kho sīhassa senāpatissa yo ahosi gamikābhisaṅkhāro bhagavantaṃ dassanāya so paṭippassambhi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.3.10: tatiyampi kho abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyānena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.3.12: “nissaṃsayaṃ kho so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhavissati. tathā hi me abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.3.13: kiṃ hi me karissanti nigaṇṭhā apalokitā vā anapalokitā vā? yannūnāhaṃ kiṃ hi me karissanti nigaṇṭhā apalokitā vā anapalokitā vā?
pli-tv-kd6:31.3.14: yannūnāhaṃ anapaloketvāva nigaṇṭhe taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddha”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.1: atha kho sīho senāpati pañcahi rathasatehi divādivassa vesāliyā nīyyāsi bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikova yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.4: “sutammetaṃ bhante, akiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.5: ye te bhante evamāhaṃsu: akiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī’ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.6: kacci te bhante, bhagavato vuttavādino? na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti? dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti? na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati?
pli-tv-kd6:31.5.1: “atthi sīha, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd6:31.5.2: ‘akiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī’ti.

pli-tv-kd6:31.8.1: “katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.2: ‘venayiko samaṇo gotamo vinayāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī’ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.3: ahaṃ hi sīha, vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi rāgassa dosassa mohassa.
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.4: anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.5: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.6: ‘venayiko samaṇo gotamo vinayāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī’ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.7: “katamo ca, sīha, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.8: ‘tapassī samaṇo gotamo tapassitāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī’ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.9: tapanīyāhaṃ sīha, pāpake akusale dhamme vadāmi
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.11: yassa kho sīha, tapanīyā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīṇā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, tamahaṃ tapassīti vadāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.12: tathāgatassa kho sīha, tapanīyā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīṇā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
pli-tv-kd6:31.8.13: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya: tapassī samaṇo gotamo tapassitāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī’ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.1: “katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.2: ‘apagabbho samaṇo gotamo apagabbhatāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī’ti?
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.3: yassa kho sīha, āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhavābhinibbatti pahīṇā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, tamahaṃ apagabbhoti vadāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.4: tathāgatassa kho sīha, āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhavābhinibbatti pahīṇā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.5: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.6: ‘apagabbho samaṇo gotamo apagabbhatāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī’ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.7: “katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.8: ‘assattho samaṇo gotamo assāsāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī’ti?
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.9: ahaṃ hi sīha, assatthoparamena assāsena. assāsāya ca dhammaṃ desemi. tena ca sāvake vinemi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.10: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd6:31.9.11: ‘assattho samaṇo gotamo assāsāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.1: evaṃ vutte sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.2: “abhikkantaṃ bhante. abhikkantaṃ bhante. seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya: ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī’ ti, evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito. esāhaṃ, bhante, tatiyampi bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.4: anuviccakāraṃ kho sīha, karohi. anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.5: imināpahaṃ bhante bhagavato vacanena bhiyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho, yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha:
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.6: “anuviccakāraṃ kho sīha, karohi. anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.7: mamaṃ hi bhante aññatitthiyā sāvakaṃ labhitvā kevalakappaṃ vesāliṃ paṭākaṃ parihareyyuṃ: “sīho amhākaṃ senāpati sāvakattaṃ upagato’ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.8: atha ca pana maṃ bhagavā evamāha:
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.9: “anuviccakāraṃ kho sīha, karohi. anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.10: esāhaṃ bhante dutiyampi bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.11: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.1: dīgharattaṃ kho te sīha, nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ, yena tesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍakaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.2: imināpāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato bhīyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho, yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha:
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.3: “dīgharattaṃ kho te sīha, nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ, yena tesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍakaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.5: mayhameva dānaṃ dātabbaṃ. na aññesaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ. mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ. na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.6: mayhameva dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ. na aññesaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ. mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ. na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphala”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.7: atha ca pana maṃ bhagavā nigaṇṭhesupi dāne samādapeti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.8: api ca bhante, mayamettha kālaṃ jānissāma.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.9: esāhaṃ bhante, tatiyampi bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.10: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata nti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.1: atha kho bhagavā sīhassa senāpatissa anupubbīkathaṃ kathesi seyyathidaṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ. nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi. yadā bhagavā aññāsi sīhasenāpatiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi: dukkhaṃ samudayaṃ nirodhaṃ maggaṃ. seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya, evameva sīhassa senāpatissa tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi: “yaṃkiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma”nti. atha kho sīho senāpati diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.4: “adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.6: atha kho sīho senāpati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.7: atha kho sīho senāpati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.9: atha kho sīho senāpati tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi. “kālo bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhatta”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.10: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena sīhassa senāpatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nigaṇṭhā vesāliyaṃ rathiyā rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ bāhā paggayha kandanti:
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.2: “ajja sīhena senāpatinā thullaṃ pasuṃ vadhitvā samaṇassa gotamassa bhattaṃ kataṃ. taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakaṭaṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamma”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.3: atha kho aññataro puriso yena sīho senāpati tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā sīhassa senāpatissa upakaṇṇake ārocesi:
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.4: “yagghe bhante, jāneyyāsi? ete sambahulā nigaṇṭhā vesāliyaṃ rathiyā rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ bāhā paggayha kandanti:
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.5: ajja sīhena senāpatinā thullaṃ pasuṃ vadhitvā samaṇassa gotamassa bhattaṃ kataṃ. taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakaṭaṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamma”’nti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.6: “alaṃ ayyo, dīgharattampi te āyasmantā avaṇṇakāmā buddhassa. avaṇṇakāmā dhammassa. avaṇṇakāmā saṅghassa.
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.7: na ca pana te āyasmantā jirinti taṃ bhagavantaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhantā.
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.8: na ca mayaṃ jīvitahetūpi sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyyāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.14.1: atha kho sīho senāpati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.14.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho sīhaṃ senāpatiṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.14.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:31.14.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave, tikoṭiparisuddhaṃ macchamaṃsaṃ: adiṭṭhaṃ asutaṃ aparisaṅkita”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:32.1.1: tena kho pana samayena vesālī subhikkhā hoti susassā sulabhapiṇḍā. sukarā uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:32.1.2: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd6:32.1.3: “yāni tāni mayā bhikkhūnaṃ anuññātāni dubbhikkhe dussasse dullabhapiṇḍe anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ, uggahitapaṭiggahitakaṃ tato nīhaṭaṃ, purebhattaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ, vanaṭṭhaṃ, pokkharaṭṭhaṃ, ajjāpi nu kho tāni bhikkhū paribhuñjantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:32.1.4: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:32.1.5: “yāni tāni ānanda, mayā bhikkhūnaṃ anuññātāni dubbhikkhe dussasse dullabhapiṇḍe anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ, uggahitapaṭiggahitakaṃ, tato nīhaṭaṃ, purebhattaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ, vanaṭṭhaṃ pokkharaṭṭhaṃ, ajjāpi nu kho tāni bhikkhū paribhuñjantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:32.2.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:32.2.2: “yāni tāni bhikkhave, mayā bhikkhūnaṃ anuññātāni dubbhikkhe dussasse dullabhapiṇḍe anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ, uggahitapaṭiggahitakaṃ, tato nīhaṭaṃ, purebhattaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ, vanaṭṭhaṃ pokkharaṭṭhaṃ, tānāhaṃ ajjatagge paṭikkhipāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:32.2.3: na bhikkhave, anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ uggahitapaṭiggahitakaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:32.2.5: na ca bhikkhave, tato nīhaṭaṃ, purebhattaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ, vanaṭṭhaṃ, pokkharaṭṭhaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:33.1.1: tena kho pana samayena jānapadā manussā bahuṃ loṇampi telampi taṇḍulampi khādanīyampi sakaṭesu āropetvā bahārāmakoṭṭhake sakaṭaparivattaṃ karitvā acchanti: “yadā paṭipāṭiṃ labhissāma, tadā bhattaṃ karissāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:33.1.3: atha kho te manussā yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ: “idha bhante ānanda, bahuṃ loṇampi telampi taṇḍulampi khādanīyampi sakaṭesu āropitā tiṭṭhanti, mahā ca megho uggato. kathannukho bhante ānanda, paṭipajjitabba”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:33.1.4: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.

pli-tv-kd6:34.10.1: atha kho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena bhaddiyaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi.

pli-tv-kd6:34.11.2: “samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito bhaddiyaṃ anuppatto bhaddiye viharati jātiyāvane.

pli-tv-kd6:34.12.5: “kiṃ pana tvaṃ gahapati, kiriyavādo samāno akiriyavādaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissasi?

pli-tv-kd6:34.13.7: “abhikkantaṃ bhante abhikkantaṃ bhante. seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya: ‘cakkhunto rūpāni dakkhintī’ti, evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito. esāhaṃ bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.

pli-tv-kd6:34.21.6: santi bhikkhave, manussā saddhā pasannā. te kappiyakārakānaṃ hatthe hiraññaṃ upanikkhipanti:
pli-tv-kd6:34.21.8: anujānāmi. bhikkhave, yaṃ tato kappiyaṃ taṃ sādiyituṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:34.21.9: na tvevāhaṃ bhikkhave, kenaci pariyāyena jātarūparajataṃ sādiyitabbaṃ pariyesitabbanti. vadāmī”ti.

pli-tv-kd6:35.3.1: “samaṇopi gotamo rattūparato virato vikālabhojanā. arahati samaṇopi gotamo evarūpāni pānāni sādiyitu”nti
pli-tv-kd6:35.3.2: pahūtaṃ pānaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā kājehi gāhāpetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
pli-tv-kd6:35.3.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

pli-tv-kd6:35.4.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi. samādapesi. samuttejesi. sampahaṃsesi.

pli-tv-kd6:35.4.4: “adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.

pli-tv-kd6:36.1.1: atha kho bhagavā āpaṇe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena kusinārā, tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.1.2: assosuṃ kho kosinārakā mallā “bhagavā kira kusināraṃ āgacchati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.1.3: te saṅgaraṃ akaṃsu: “yo bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ na karissati, pañcasatānissa daṇḍo”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.1.4: tena kho pana samayena rojo mallo āyasmato ānandassa sahāyo hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.1.5: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena kusinārā, tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.1: atha kho kosinārakā mallā bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ akaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.2: atha kho rojo mallo bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ karitvā yenāyasmā ānando, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.3: ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho rojaṃ mallaṃ āyasmā ānando etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.4: “uḷāraṃ kho te imaṃ āvuso roja, yaṃ tvaṃ bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ akāsī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.5: “nāhaṃ, bhante ānanda, bahukato buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.6: api ca ñātīhi saṅgaro kato: ‘yo bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ na karissati, pañcasatānissa daṇḍo’ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.7: so kho ahaṃ bhante ānanda, ñātīnaṃ daṇḍabhayā evāhaṃ bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ akāsi”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.8: atha kho āyasmā ānando anattamano ahosi: “kathaṃ hi nāma rojo mallo evaṃ vakkhatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.3.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:36.3.4: mahiddhiko kho pana evarūpānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pasādo.

pli-tv-kd6:36.4.1: atha kho bhagavā rojaṃ mallaṃ mettena cittena pharitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.

pli-tv-kd6:36.4.3: evameva, vihārena vihāraṃ pariveṇena pariveṇaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhū pucchati:
pli-tv-kd6:36.4.4: “kahannu kho bhante etarahi so bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho? dassanakāmā hi mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddha”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.4.5: “esāvuso roja, vihāro saṃvutadvāro. tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno ālindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭehi, vivarissati te bhagavā dvāra”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.1: atha kho rojo mallo yena so vihāro saṃvutadvāro, tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno ālindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi. vivari bhagavā dvāraṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.2: atha kho rojo mallo vihāraṃ pavisitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho rojassa mallassa bhagavā ānupubbīkathaṃ kathesi; seyyathīdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.4: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi. yadā bhagavā aññāsi rojaṃ mallaṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi: dukkhaṃ samudayaṃ nirodhaṃ maggaṃ seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya, evameva kho rojassa mallassa tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi: “yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma”nti. atha kho rojo mallo diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.6: “sādhu bhante, ayyā mamaññeva patigaṇheyyuṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ, no aññesa”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.7: “yesaṃ kho roja, sekhena ñāṇena sekhena dassanena dhammo diṭṭho seyyathāpi tayā, tesampi evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.8: ‘aho nūna ayyā amhākaññeva patigaṇheyyuṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ, no aññesa’nti.

pli-tv-kd6:37.1.1: atha kho bhagavā kusinārāyaṃ yathābhirattaṃ viharitvā yena ātumā, tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi.

pli-tv-kd6:37.2.1: assosi kho so buḍḍhapabbajito “bhagavā kira ātumaṃ āgacchati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:37.2.2: atha kho so buḍḍhapabbajito te dārake etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd6:37.2.3: “bhagavā kira tātā, ātumaṃ āgacchati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi.

pli-tv-kd6:37.3.2: manussā te dārake mañjuke paṭibhāṇeyyake passitvā yepi na kārāpetukāmā, tepi kārāpenti, kārāpetvāpi bahuṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd6:37.3.3: atha kho te dārakā bahuṃ loṇampi telampi taṇḍulampi khādanīyampi saṃhariṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:37.4.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena ātumā tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd6:37.4.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā ātumāyaṃ viharati bhusāgāre.

pli-tv-kd6:37.4.9: atha kho so buḍḍhapabbajito bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.2: ‘ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisa, ananulomikaṃ appatirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.3: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa, pabbajite akappiye samādapessasi.
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.5: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.6: “na bhikkhave, pabbajitā akappiye samādapetabbā. yo samādapeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.7: na ca bhikkhave, nahāpitapubbena khurabhaṇḍaṃ pariharitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:38.1.1: atha kho bhagavā ātumāyaṃ yathābhirattaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:38.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthi tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd6:38.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd6:38.1.4: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ bahuṃ phalakhādanīyaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:38.1.6: “kinnu kho bhagavatā phalakhādanīya anuññātaṃ? kiṃ ananuññāta”nti.
pli-tv-kd6:39.1.1: tena kho pana samayena saṅghikāni bījāni puggalikāya bhūmiyā ropiyanti, puggalikāni bījāni saṅghikāya bhūmiyā ropiyanti.
pli-tv-kd6:39.1.3: “saṅghikāni bhikkhave, bījāni puggalikāya bhūmiyā ropitāni bhāgaṃ datvā paribhuñjitabbāni.
pli-tv-kd6:39.1.4: puggalikāni bījāni saṅghikāya bhūmiyā ropitāni bhāgaṃ datvā paribhuñjitabbānī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:40.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ kismiñci kismiñci ṭhāne kukkuccaṃ uppajjati:
pli-tv-kd6:40.1.4: “yaṃ bhikkhave, mayā ‘idaṃ na kappatī’ti appaṭikkhittaṃ taṃ ce akappiyaṃ anulometi, kappiyaṃ paṭibāhati, taṃ vo na kappati.
pli-tv-kd6:40.1.5: yaṃ bhikkhave, mayā ‘idaṃ na kappatī’ti appaṭikkhittaṃ, taṃ ce kappiyaṃ anulometi, akappiyaṃ paṭibāhati, taṃ vo kappati.
pli-tv-kd6:40.1.6: yaṃ bhikkhave, mayā ‘idaṃ kappatī’ti ananuññātaṃ, taṃ ce akappiyaṃ anulometi, kappiyaṃ paṭibāhati, taṃ vo na kappati.
pli-tv-kd6:40.1.7: yaṃ bhikkhave, mayā ‘idaṃ kappatī’ti ananuññātaṃ, taṃ ce kappiyaṃ anulometi, akappiyaṃ paṭibāhati, taṃ vo kappatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:40.2.2: “kappati nu kho yāvakālikena yāmakālikaṃ? na nu kho kappati?
pli-tv-kd6:40.2.3: kappati nu kho yāvakālikena sattāhakālikaṃ? na nu kho kappati?
pli-tv-kd6:40.2.4: kappati nu kho yāvakālikena yāvajīvikaṃ? na nu kho kappati?
pli-tv-kd6:40.2.5: kappati nu kho yāmakālikena sattāhakālikaṃ? na nu kho kappati?
pli-tv-kd6:40.2.6: kappati nu kho yāmakālikena yāvajīvikaṃ? na nu kho kappati?
pli-tv-kd6:40.2.7: kappati nu kho sattāhakālikena yāvajīvikaṃ? na nu kho kappatī?”ti.
pli-tv-kd6:40.3.1: “yāvakālikena bhikkhave, yāmakālikaṃ, tadahu paṭiggahitaṃ kāle kappati, vikāle na kappati.
pli-tv-kd6:40.3.2: yāvakālikena bhikkhave, sattāhakālikaṃ tadahu paṭiggahitaṃ kāle kappati. vikāle na kappati.
pli-tv-kd6:40.3.3: yāvakālikena bhikkhave, yāvajīvikaṃ tadahu paṭiggahitaṃ kāle kappati, vikāle na kappati.
pli-tv-kd6:40.3.4: yāmakālikena bhikkhave, sattāhakālikaṃ tadahu paṭiggahitaṃ yāme kappati. yāmātikkante na kappati.
pli-tv-kd6:40.3.5: yāmakālikena bhikkhave, yāvajīvikaṃ tadahu paṭiggahitaṃ yāme kappati. yāmātikkante na kappati.
pli-tv-kd6:40.3.6: sattāhakālikena bhikkhave, yāvajīvikaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ sattāhaṃ kappati. sattāhātikkante na kappatī”ti.
